description_for_human: Find skate parks welcoming to older skaters, local skate shops, and older-skater communities in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.
description_for_model: Use this to find skateboard parks welcoming to older skaters, local skate shops with knowledgeable staff, and skating community groups for older adults in English-speaking countries (US, UK, Canada, Australia). It also provides guides and advice for adults returning to skateboarding after a long break.
